Malaysia says it will send thousands of migrants and refugees back to Myanmar, despite acknowledging that many asylum seekers in the country had been victims of “atrocities” carried ​out by the junta in Naypyidaw.

Malaysia’s prime minister, Anwar Ibrahim, said on Tuesday that the deportations were in line with advice from the international court of justice (ICJ), which was “to guarantee a safe and dignified return” for those fleeing persecution, and his country had not abandoned its principles of upholding the rights of the people of Myanmar .

Ukraine has confirmed it deployed naval drones in strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya on Sunday, including one that sank the corvette Merkury, one of Russia’s newest vessels.
Ukraine’s security service, the SBU, said seven domestically made naval drones were launched from a mothership in the operation, which Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as “exemplary”.

items.sintesis: Brian Morales García of Texas seeks damages after he was wrongly identified as undocumented in case White House wants dropped The Trump administration recently admitted in federal court that it deported a US citizen to Mexico after American authorities incorrectly concluded he was an undocumented immigrant.
puntos: Brian Morales García of Texas seeks damages after he was wrongly identified as undocumented in case White House wants dropped
The Trump administration recently admitted in federal court that it deported a US citizen to Mexico after American authorities incorrectly concluded he was an undocumented immigrant.

Attorneys for the US justice department made that admission on Friday while requesting the dismissal of a lawsuit for damages that the deported man – Brian José Morales García of Austin, Texas – has been pursuing against the federal government.

items.sintesis: El gobierno de Fujimori diluye las reformas prometidas y muestra dificultades para conducir un sector golpeado por epidemias y amenazado por El Niño. L a pandemia dejó al descubierto la precariedad del sistema de salud peruano: servicios fragmentados, financiamiento segmentado y una descentralización que transfirió responsabilidades sin asegurar capacidades.
puntos: El gobierno de Fujimori diluye las reformas prometidas y muestra dificultades para conducir un sector golpeado por epidemias y amenazado por El Niño.
